notes_for_editor: Keeper dates rest on Lighthouse Friends alone (marine_ca keeper tables are OCR column blocks; not matched). Fire after 1885: LF says 1958, heritage register says 1959; built 1959-60 vs 1960. Staffing: LF automated 1991, register says staffed. Printed page numbers for the 1906, 1906-07, 1907-08 and 1901 volumes taken from corpus.py (1907-08 p.52 and 1901 p.42 from grep labels). Fiscal-year dating of Cheltonian wreck not worked out. Ascania date inferred: July 3 within fiscal year ended 31 March 1919 = 1918. 'Hexagonal' tower 41 ft = 12.5 m. Parks Canada DFHD pages did not load (placeholder only), so register pages used. Checker: Cheltonian date derived from fiscal year ended 31 March 1916 (May 1915). 'Rennie family' relationship not sourced, story says only shared surname. Federal Heritage Building status of the tower itself is not shown in the register text read; only LF's 2007 note about the small building. Owner: LF says Canadian Coast Guard; record says Fisheries and Oceans Canada (Coast Guard sits within DFO). Osborne/Thomas hand-over set to about 1978 for 'late 1970s'.
